release_notes.scope: 158,955 families / 488,016 captured versions rebuilt deterministically from retained raw SPL ZIPs with parser spl-sections-0.2.4 (Step E inventory plus a delta of 26 admitted versions). 56 versions have no retained raw (status no_raw) and carry no text. The 26 delta-admitted versions, which the earlier 0.2.3 builds could not read (XML nesting deeper than 256 levels), are now parsed. Not a national completeness claim; upstream history beyond the evidence inventory is unknown.

validation.caution: Earlier tranche1 59/60 and 60/60 scores were AI-graded, not human-reviewed, and are not validation. No independent clinical validation exists.
